skill.name: tieba-demand-insights
skill.description: Analyze Baidu Tieba posts and replies through SocialDataX to identify product needs, pain points, purchase concerns, and frequently asked questions.
skill.summary: Turn bounded Tieba discussion samples into demand reports with quotations, source references, and evidence limitations.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: All 39 static alerts are false positives involving Markdown, documented authentication, provider links, discussion identifiers, or readable multilingual text. One semantic finding concerns automatic execution of an unpinned npm package that can access the configured API key. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential theft, or destructive instructions in the supplied files; the external package implementation was not reviewed.

remediation.issue: The CLI examples automatically execute socialdatax-skills@latest, and installation metadata does not pin a package version.
remediation.suggestion: Use a reviewed exact version in every command and installation entry, verify package integrity, and request approval before executing downloaded code.

semantic_findings.title: Automatic Execution of an Unpinned npm Package
semantic_findings.description: The examples use npx -y socialdatax-skills@latest, automatically fetching and executing a mutable package version. A compromised release could execute local code and access the configured API key; the package implementation is outside the supplied files.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The explicit @latest selector and -y option permit changing downloaded code to run without an installation prompt. This establishes supply-chain exposure, not evidence that the package is malicious.

content.user_title: Analyze Tieba Discussions for Product Needs
content.value_statement: Product teams need traceable evidence behind scattered Tieba complaints and purchase questions. This skill guides bounded SocialDataX retrieval and organizes discussions into source-backed demand reports.
actual_capabilities: Search Tieba posts by keyword, search within a named forum, or retrieve a forum post list through SocialDataX.
Retrieve post details and comments by thread ID or URL, and nested replies by thread and comment IDs.
Organize discussion evidence into user needs, usage scenarios, pain points, purchase concerns, FAQs, and proposed actions.
Attach short quotations, post references, available comment identifiers, and evidence-strength assessments to reported themes.
Report sample size and missing information while separating firsthand experiences, questions, secondhand reports, and analysis.
Guide bounded pagination and partial-result recovery while preserving original collection limits.
limitations: Live retrieval requires SocialDataX access, a configured API key, and sufficient account credits.
The supplied files contain instructions, not the external CLI implementation; direct execution requires Node.js, npm, and network access.
Small discussion samples cannot establish population prevalence, and unavailable comments limit conclusions to post-level leads.
The workflow is read-only and does not log in, publish posts, like content, submit comments, or modify accounts.

use_cases.title: Identify Product Improvement Candidates
use_cases.description: Review a bounded set of relevant discussions to connect recurring complaints with usage scenarios and supporting quotations.

use_cases.title: Prepare Purchase-Concern Messaging
use_cases.description: Collect pre-purchase questions from a named forum and distinguish unanswered concerns from firsthand product experiences.

use_cases.title: Draft Evidence-Backed Support FAQs
use_cases.description: Read selected posts and comment threads to organize common questions, evidence gaps, and candidate support topics.

prompt_templates.title: Start with a Small Sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Research Tieba discussions about [product keyword]. Start with one search page and select up to three relevant posts. Summarize pain points with quotations and source references.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate a Specific Thread
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [Tieba post URL or ID] and its comments. Add nested replies only where needed. Separate firsthand experiences, questions, and secondhand statements. Cite each reported concern.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Purchase Concerns
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [product] in [forum name] using [keywords]. Limit collection to [page limit] pages and [item limit] items. Group purchase concerns and FAQs. Deduplicate repeated statements. Report evidence strength and missing information.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Bounded Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate [research question] across [named forums] using [keywords]. Confirm scope and collection limits first. Separate product needs, usage scenarios, and purchase concerns. Cite quotations and available post and comment IDs. Distinguish observations from proposed actions. Preserve partial results and resume only within remaining limits. Report sample counts, duplicate handling, and unresolved evidence gaps.

output_examples.input: Illustrative supplied sample: Post A says, 'The fan is too loud at night.' Summarize the product need.
output: Evidence: 'The fan is too loud at night.' Source: supplied Post A.
Candidate action: Investigate nighttime noise expectations.
Boundary: One illustrative statement; frequency and wider demand are unknown.

output_examples.input: Illustrative supplied sample: Post B asks, 'Does the battery last a full workday?' Comments are unavailable. Identify the purchase concern.
output: Purchase concern: Battery endurance during a workday.
Evidence: 'Does the battery last a full workday?' Source: supplied Post B.
FAQ candidate: What battery life should buyers expect during typical work?
Boundary: This is a question, not evidence of battery failure; no comment evidence is available.

best_practices: Define the product, forum scope, and collection limits before retrieval; begin with one page and a few relevant discussions.
Keep quotations and source identifiers with each theme; report sample counts, duplicate handling, and evidence gaps.
Use a reviewed, pinned CLI version and protect the API key; approve dependency changes before execution.
anti_patterns: Treating sample mention counts as population percentages or counting repeated statements as independent demand.
Presenting questions, secondhand claims, or analyst interpretations as verified firsthand product failures.
Collecting entire forums automatically or inferring sensitive identities from discussion content.

faq.question: What inputs can I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a product keyword, topic, forum name, Tieba post URL, or thread ID.

faq.question: What setup does live retrieval require?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY for SocialDataX. Direct CLI use also requires Node.js, npm, network access, and permission to execute the package.

faq.question: Does retrieval require account credits?
faq.answer: The instructions anticipate SocialDataX balance errors. Sufficient credits may be required; no pricing or free-access guarantee is provided.

faq.question: Can this skill post or modify my Tieba account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow only retrieves data. It does not log in, post, like, comment, or change account settings.

faq.question: How are conclusions supported?
faq.answer: Reports attach short quotations and available post or comment references. They distinguish evidence types and state sample limits.

faq.question: Does read-only research mean local execution is risk-free?
faq.answer: No. The examples execute socialdatax-skills@latest through npx. Review and pin the package before granting execution access or exposing credentials.
